name: antigravity-council
description: Consult multiple AI models in parallel — Claude, Gemini, GPT and more — to get diverse perspectives on architecture decisions, debugging dead-ends, security reviews, framework choices, and any question where one model's bias could mislead you. Answers arrive side by side with a synthesis of consensus, divergence, and recommendation.
suggestedPrompts: Ask the council: Should I use UUID or BIGINT primary keys for a SaaS users table?
Council review: Is our authentication flow secure?
Get the council's take: SQLite vs Postgres for a single-node demo app
